dataset_partition: DEVELOPMENT (authenticated in-memory TestClient(app) probes across route modes local-first/live/staging-replay on solvable, complete-refusal vmmu_r460, and partial-parse vmmu_r537/vmmu_r277 inputs; never sealed H-1 or locked W2/W3)
expected_behavior: HTTP 503 (Cache-Control: no-store, failure_kind='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE') is emitted ONLY when an operational dependency or live AI fallback required to continue processing is unavailable (LIVE_AI_DISABLED when ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0, MISSING_API_KEY when ALLOW_LIVE_AI!=0 and API key is absent, STAGING_CORPUS_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_HYBRID_ROUTE_MODE, USAGE_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE, maintenance_mode, VisionProviderUnavailable, SMTP failure). Complete/ambiguous local-first refusals (LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE, LOCAL_PARSE_AMBIGUOUS, GATE_OUT_OF_SCOPE) return HTTP 200 structured envelopes (envelope.status='unsupported', route_d.status='REFUSED', Cache-Control: no-store) with 0 provider calls. When HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST=1 with HYBRID_ROUTE_MODE=live and ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0, solvable and complete-refusal geometry problems still execute locally with 0 AI calls instead of failing before local-first dispatch. When fallback is blocked by MISSING_API_KEY (ALLOW_LIVE_AI=1, empty key), reason_code is MISSING_API_KEY (not misreported as LIVE_AI_DISABLED) and still carries local_understanding diagnostics.
actual_behavior: Stage P0 Phase 2 fixes implemented and verified while preserving all locked 503 contract tests: (1) Fixed API-1 & API-3 in hybrid_offline.py, adaptive_input_router.py, and main.py: when ALLOW_LIVE_AI=1 and GEMINI_API_KEY is empty on a LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL input, POST /api/analyze now returns HTTP 503 with reason_code='MISSING_API_KEY' (no longer misreported as LIVE_AI_DISABLED), failure_kind='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE', failure_dimension='INFRASTRUCTURE_AVAILABILITY', taxonomy_class='INFRASTRUCTURE_UNAVAILABLE', clean Vietnamese error text (0 _TECH regex matches), and structured local_understanding; (2) Fixed API-2 in main.py:1248-1255: when HYBRID_ROUTE_MODE=live and HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST=1 with ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0, local-first execution runs BEFORE the live AI kill-switch, serving solvable LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE problems as HTTP 200 SERVED (0 AI calls) and complete refusals (e.g. vmmu_r460) as HTTP 200 structured envelopes, while keeping plain 503 LIVE_AI_DISABLED when HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST is unset; (3) Preserved locked HTTP 503 + LIVE_AI_DISABLED + local_understanding contract on LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL under HYBRID_ROUTE_MODE=local-first + ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0.
mathematical_oracle: Deterministic HTTP status & JSON schema state machine over (HYBRID_ROUTE_MODE, HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST, ALLOW_LIVE_AI, api_key_present, LocalParseResult.status): (1) LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE -> SERVED (HTTP 200, route_d.status='SERVED') or REFUSED (HTTP 200, envelope.status='unsupported', route_d.status='REFUSED'); (2) LOCAL_PARSE_AMBIGUOUS -> REFUSED (HTTP 200, envelope.status='unsupported', reason_code='AMBIGUOUS_FACT'); (3) LOCAL_PARSE_UNSUPPORTED + GATE_OUT_OF_SCOPE -> HTTP 200 (envelope.status='unsupported', error_code='gate_out_of_scope'); (4) LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL or non-gate LOCAL_PARSE_UNSUPPORTED when fallback blocked -> HTTP 503 Cache-Control: no-store, failure_kind='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE', retryable=false, reason_code='LIVE_AI_DISABLED' (iff ALLOW_LIVE_AI=='0') else 'MISSING_API_KEY' (iff not api_key), carrying local_understanding with orthogonal failure_dimension and taxonomy_class.

status_change_503_to_200_or_422_on_local.reason: In HYBRID_ROUTE_MODE='local-first' (where AI fallback is part of the route design and only blocked operationally by ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0), 5 existing test suites explicitly assert HTTP 503 + reason_code='LIVE_AI_DISABLED' + failure_kind='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE' + local_understanding: test_grounded_vietnamese_understanding.py:203, test_semantic_failure_diagnostics.py:42, test_adaptive_input_router.py:154, photo-problem-flow.test.ts:148, verify-hybrid-product-e2e.mjs:592. Furthermore, AGENTS.md section 3 mandates never mislabeling a blocked live fallback as a final mathematical refusal when live extraction could have parsed the unread clause.
status_change_503_to_200_or_422_on_local.safe_compatible_resolution: 1) Keep HTTP 200 (envelope.status='unsupported', route_d.status='REFUSED', Cache-Control: no-store) for ALL complete/ambiguous local parses and domain-gate refusals; 2) Keep HTTP 503 (Cache-Control: no-store, failure_kind='INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE', retryable=false) when LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL / non-gate LOCAL_PARSE_UNSUPPORTED requires live AI fallback that is blocked by ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0 or MISSING_API_KEY, enriched with local_understanding carrying orthogonal failure_dimension, taxonomy_class, root_cause, unread_excerpts, and rewrite_may_help; 3) Confirm frontend client.ts:157 already treats HTTP 503 as non-transient (0 automatic retries), idempotency.py:100 does not cache 503, main.py:1341 does not cache REFUSED 200 or 503, and usage ledger refunds quota on both.

surgical_p0_api_fixes.change: Pass allow_live_ai and api_key separately (or fallback_block_reason='LIVE_AI_DISABLED' vs 'MISSING_API_KEY') from LocalFirstHybridRun.run into route_text_input so ALLOW_LIVE_AI=1 + empty key emits reason_code='MISSING_API_KEY' (instead of LIVE_AI_DISABLED), and attach local_understanding + learner-safe explanation in _hybrid_infra_error for BOTH LIVE_AI_DISABLED and MISSING_API_KEY, plus explicit retryable=False and orthogonal taxonomy fields inside local_understanding.

Compute use_local_first = (mode == 'local-first' or os.getenv('HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST') == '1') BEFORE line 1250 so 'if mode == live and not use_local_first and os.getenv(ALLOW_LIVE_AI) == 0' preserves test_the_kill_switch_without_a_local_parse_keeps_its_plain_message (mode='live', HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST!='1') while allowing HYBRID_LOCAL_FIRST=1 to serve solvable problems locally with 0 AI calls when ALLOW_LIVE_AI=0.

Preserve output-policy/1 (backend/app/simulation/geometry_functions/output_policy.py) and exact 6-key envelope contract on HTTP 200 refusals; never store HTTP 200 REFUSED or HTTP 503 in SimulationCache or Idempotency replay (for 5xx).
